recipe_version.title: Orecchiette with Italian Sausage, Broccoli Rabe, Garlic, and Pecorino
recipe_version.description: Dried orecchiette tossed with crumbled browned Italian sausage, blanched broccoli rabe cooked down with garlic, chile flakes, and olive oil, loosened with starchy cooking liquid and finished with grated Pecorino Romano and lemon zest.

ingredients.name: broccoli rabe
ingredients.preparation: tough ends trimmed, cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: Italian sausage
ingredients.display_name: sweet or hot Italian sausage whose label lists pork, salt, spices, fennel, and garlic

ingredients.name: orecchiette
ingredients.display_name: dried orecchiette whose label lists durum wheat semolina and water

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Trim the broccoli rabe and cut into 2-inch pieces. Slice the garlic, grate the Pecorino, and zest the lemon. Remove the sausage casings.

steps.title: Boil and blanch
steps.body: Bring 12 cups water and 1 tbsp salt to a boil in the 6-quart pot over high, about 12 minutes to come to a boil. Blanch the rabe 2 minutes and lift it out with the slotted spoon.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: While the pot heats (overlap stated): heat 1 tbsp oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Cook the sausage, breaking it into small crumbles, until browned with no pink, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.body: Cook the orecchiette in the 6-quart pot of 12 cups water until al dente, about 12 minutes. Scoop out 1 cup pasta cooking liquid in the liquid measuring cup, then drain in the colander.

steps.title: Garlic and rabe
steps.body: While the pasta cooks (overlap stated): push the sausage aside, add 2 tbsp oil, the garlic, and the chile flakes to the skillet over medium, and cook until the garlic is pale golden, about 2 minutes. Add the rabe and cook, tossing, 3 minutes.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.body: Add the pasta and 1/2 cup pasta cooking liquid to the skillet and toss over medium until glossy, about 2 minutes, adding more liquid if dry. Off the heat, toss in half the Pecorino and the lemon zest. Serve with the rest of the cheese.
